description: 图谱人物命名策略迁移与可配置化 — 将硬编码的人物命名规则迁移到书籍级配置，统一 service.py 与 graph_service.py 的重复规则

userStories.title: 抽离统一人物命名策略模块
userStories.description: As a backend developer, I want a single graph name policy module so that all graph-related naming/alias rules come from one place and never diverge.
acceptanceCriteria: 新增模块 novel_system/graph_name_policy.py
对外暴露接口：规范化 (normalize_name)、别名归并 (merge_aliases)、候选过滤 (filter_candidates)
service.py 与 graph_service.py 不再各自维护重复的人名规范化/过滤逻辑
现有相关测试通过
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: graph_name_policy.py already existed with normalize_name/resolve_aliases/filter_candidates. Added merge_aliases() for merging {canonical: [aliases]} sources. Refactored service.py to use merge_aliases from graph_name_policy instead of directly iterating ALIAS_MAP. Removed dead code (unreachable return in resolve_aliases_with_profile). All 261 tests pass.

userStories.title: 书籍级 graph 配置外置
userStories.description: As a data/operator, I want per-book graph profile files so that novel-specific knowledge is managed as data instead of hardcoded patches.
acceptanceCriteria: 支持读取 books/{book_id}/graph_profile.json
GRAPH_CANON_SEEDS / GRAPH_ALIAS_LOOKUP 从代码常量迁出到配置层
配置缺失时回落到默认启发式，不因缺文件导致流程中断
配置 schema 支持：人物种子、别名、少量人工修正字段
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Created graph_profile.json for both books (凡人修仙传 and 凡人修仙传-1-500章-txt). Removed direct GRAPH_CANON_SEEDS import from orchestrator.py — now accepts character_names parameter. Threaded character_names through HybridRetriever → SearchOrchestrator. service.py loads graph_profile via load_graph_profile() in _retrieve and _retrieve_with_rewrite, passing character_seeds to retriever. 6 new tests in TestConfigLayerOverride verify config loading, fallback behavior, and that orchestrator no longer imports constants directly. All 267 tests pass.

userStories.title: 索引阶段人物候选抽取
userStories.description: As a retrieval/graph engineer, I want character candidate extraction during indexing so that potential character names are identified early in the pipeline.
acceptanceCriteria: 索引阶段产出人物候选集合
候选抽取基于分词和词性标注识别潜在人名
抽取结果可序列化存储
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Added jieba POS tagging (nr tag) to SceneSegmentBuilder._extract_person_names() alongside existing regex patterns. POS tagging identifies person names that regex misses (e.g. 令狐冲, 任盈盈 with non-standard surnames). Added filtering for false positives (武功/功/法 endings). Added 5 new tests in test_scene_segments.py: POS extraction, regex-miss detection, non-person exclusion, JSON serializability, and deterministic output. All 272 tests pass.

userStories.title: 候选过滤三证据策略
userStories.description: As a retrieval/graph engineer, I want candidate filtering with frequency, chapter span, and scene evidence so that fake names are filtered before graph consumption.
acceptanceCriteria: 过滤至少包含三类证据：出现频率、章节跨度、场景证据
过滤逻辑在 graph_name_policy.py 中实现
过滤结果具有可重复性（同配置下稳定输出）
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Added CandidateEvidence dataclass and filter_candidates_with_evidence() to graph_name_policy.py implementing three-evidence strategy (frequency, chapter_span, scene_evidence). Added build_candidate_evidence_from_chapters() helper. Refactored indexing.py:_build_character_registry to delegate filtering to the policy module. 13 new tests cover: all-three-evidence pass, low-frequency filtering, low-score filtering, seed bonus, scene evidence score contribution, chapter span contribution, deterministic output, stable ordering, canonical-name deduplication, frequency counting, chapter span counting, empty input, and return type. All 285 tests pass.

userStories.title: 生成 character_registry 标准产物
userStories.description: As a graph pipeline maintainer, I want a character_registry with canonical names and aliases so that graph consumption uses normalized data.
acceptanceCriteria: 过滤后生成 character_registry
每个角色包含 canonical name 与 aliases
graph 构建仅消费 character_registry、character_card、event_timeline 三类标准产物
graph 侧不再直接依赖原始名字补丁常量
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Removed ALIAS_MAP hardcoded constant from indexing.py. Added book_id parameter to _build_character_cards and _build_character_registry so they load graph_profile.json per-book instead of using empty profile. _build_character_cards now derives aliases from profile (profile_alias_map) instead of ALIAS_MAP. _is_unknown_person_query in service.py now builds alias_lookup from character_registry entries instead of merge_aliases(ALIAS_MAP). Removed ALIAS_MAP imports from service.py, graph_name_policy.py, and index_pipeline.py (now accepts seed_aliases param). 6 new tests verify: profile aliases in cards, fallback without profile, registry loads profile by book_id, and no ALIAS_MAP dependency in indexing/service/policy modules. All 291 tests pass.

userStories.title: 白名单与新书自动判定
userStories.description: As an operator, I want a whitelist policy with auto-detection for new books so that migration strategy is controllable and scalable.
acceptanceCriteria: 新增可配置白名单机制
系统可自动判定新书是否在白名单中
白名单判定逻辑可测试（包含命中与未命中样例）
判定结果在日志中可追踪
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Added configurable whitelist via external data/whitelist.json (books list + auto_detect flag). Added auto_detect_book() that checks graph_profile.json presence. is_book_in_whitelist() now checks 3 sources: hardcoded GRAPH_WHITELIST, config file, auto-detection. All whitelist decisions logged at INFO level with source (hardcoded/config file/auto-detected/MISS). Added reset_whitelist_config_cache() for test isolation. 17 new tests in test_graph_name_policy.py cover: hardcoded hit/miss, config file loading (valid/missing/invalid), config file books whitelisted, auto-detect with/without profile.json, auto-detect disabled, determinism, hit/miss samples. All 308 tests pass.

userStories.title: 一次性切换与回归验证
userStories.description: As a project owner, I want one-shot migration with strict verification so that architecture is cleaned up without long-term dual maintenance.
acceptanceCriteria: 本期不保留旧实现双轨逻辑（一次性切换）
新增迁移相关测试覆盖关键路径
现有测试 + 新增测试均通过
至少在一个样书上验证人物图谱效果达预期
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Removed dead constants (GRAPH_CANON_SEEDS, GRAPH_ALIAS_LOOKUP) from graph_name_policy.py. Removed book-specific entries ('和韩立', '和张铁') from GRAPH_GENERIC_NAMES. Updated tests in test_graph_migration.py and test_graph_profile.py to not reference removed constants. Added 7 new tests in TestOneShotMigrationVerification: verify constants removed, no book-specific names in generic set, profile-based seeding works, normalization uses profile, no cross-book contamination, and sample book data verification. Verified character graph effect on sample book '凡人修仙传' - 24 seeds, 4 aliases loaded correctly, all alias resolution works. All 314 tests pass.
